CORRECTED: previous note claimed this triggers on self-inflicted drops (Overheat, Leaf Storm) -- verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (defiant): onAfterEachBoost checks `!source || target.isAlly(source)` and returns early (no trigger) in that case, so it only fires when an OPPONENT causes the drop. Same bug shape as Competitive had before its batch-1 fix -- these two abilities mirror each other exactly.
